practicalCriteria: Three channels are listed, each with a reason, a cost basis and a named owner
The budget split adds to the monthly budget, and each activity has a channel, an owner and a done date
Each of the three measures has a formula, a data source and a recorded baseline
Each outreach activity states its basis for contact, or is marked not to run until confirmed
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: baseline record of enquiries, wins and spend by source
